minutes_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / BHUSD Committee
  Will conduct a Special Meeting at the following time and place, and will address the
  agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  Municipal Gallery
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  IN-PERSON / TELEPHONIC / VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Beverly Hills Liaison Meeting
  https://beverlyhills-org.zoom.us/my/committee
  Meeting ID: 516 191 2424
  Passcode: 90210

  MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, August 24, 2023
  4:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  August 24, 2023 / 4:04 p.m.

IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian A. Gold, Councilmember Lili Bosse; Nancy Hunt Coffey, City
  Manager, Patty Acuna, Assistant Director of Community Services; Dr.
  Michael Bregy, Superintendent of Schools; Raphael Guzman, Assistant
  Superintendent; Noah Margo, BHUSD Board President, Tim Ellis,
  Executive Director Athletics/JPA; Mary Wells, BHUSD Board Clerk; Mark
  Mead, Executive Director School Safety; Rebecca Starkins, Director
  Communications & Strategic Initiatives, Stephanie Harris, Director of
  Community Services, Matthew Brown, Recreation Services Manager,
  Adrine Ovasapyan, Recreation Services Manager, Joana Torres,
  Community Services Manager, Linda Kyriazi, Recording Secretary.
  On Zoom: Judith Manouchehri, BHSUD Board Member

  1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda.
  None.

  2) JPA Agreement / Negotiations
  Dr. Michael Bregy, Beverly Hills Unified School Board (BHUSD) Superintendent,
  welcomed attendees and will present a final version of the agreement for approval by both
  the City of Beverly Hills and the Beverly Hills Unified School District.
  - Raphael Guzman, BHUSD Assistant Superintendent, reviewed the financials of the
  Joint Powers of Agreement (JPA) that had been discussed at the prior meeting:
   •  23-24: $15,000,000
  •  24-25: $15,750.000
  •  25-26: $16,500.000

  Major changes since 2019 – 2020 were reviewed:
  - Increase in utility rates
  - Increase in usage of Facilities
  - Increase in Security Staff
  - Major upgrades to fields, swim guy, courts and other facility improvements
  - A new base funding rate is needed

  The revised proposal presented to the City is as follows:
  - 2023-2024: $13,934.080
  - 2024-2025: $14,356,283 (Increase tied to CPI)
  - 2025-2026: $14,735.289 (increase tied to CPI)

  This proposal is less than the previous proposal which takes into consideration:
  - Feedback from City Staff
  - Internal discussions with the BHUSD Board of Education

  Mayor Gold requested time to review the draft revision.
  - Stephanie Harris, Director of Community Services, informed the liaisons about
  additional dollar amounts related to crossing guards since in prior years it was a
  separate agreement.
  - CCTV cameras for El Rodeo dollar amount is $1.9 which is a one-time cost for
  additional cameras and there is a yearly maintenance fee. This cost will be included
  in the new agreement.

  After a robust discussion on increases determined by either COLA, (Cost-of-Living
  Adjustment) or CPI (Consumer Price Index) it was agreed to use CPI, 3% for the second
  and third year.

  Mayor Gold proposed $13.5 million all in, which includes the crossing guards cost and CPI
  base. The CCTV cameras would be separate.

  After further discussion, for this fiscal year, the JPA will be $13.7 and will be submitted to
  the entire City Council.

  Next Steps: a revised final draft will be provided to the school board and liaisons and a
  second meeting in September will be scheduled to bring to City Council for final approval.

  Mary Wells, BHUSD, thanked all for investing in our schools, safe facilities and providing
  this space for all of our residents.

  3) Adjournment

ADJOURNMENT
Date / Time:  August 24, 2023 / 5:12 p.m.
